simple.meaning: לָבַן (lâban) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be (or become ) white ; to make bricks.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 8 times across Genesis, Exodus, Psalms, Isaiah, Daniel, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 11:3. Its contexts include family line, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לָבַן (H3835).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: לָבַן (lâban) / H3835 is traced through Genesis 11:3, Exodus 5:7, Exodus 5:14, Psalms 51:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.

occurrences.englishText: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
“You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”
Hide your face from my sins,
“Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh:
Some of those who are wise will fall, to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end; because it is yet for the time appointed.
Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined; but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand; but those who are wise will understand.
He has laid my vine waste,
